{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CcryznMmufKroy9SMbvYY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PD6XqJiR1LgUBcGijxTddi","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 -c \"\nimport pandas as pd\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\nfrom scipy.spatial.distance import mahalanobis\n\ndf = pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv')\n\nnoise_mask = (\n    (df.avg_glucose_level<20)|(df.avg_glucose_level>800)|\n    (df.bmi<10)|(df.bmi>60)|\n    (df.age>120)\n)\nclean = df[~noise_mask].copy()\n\n# risk proxy\nfor col in ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']:\n    clean[col+'_norm'] = clean[col]/clean[col].max()\nclean['risk_proxy'] = clean['age_norm']*clean['bmi_norm']*clean['avg_glucose_level_norm']\n\nfor varset in [['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level'], ['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level','risk_proxy']]:\n    X = clean[varset].values\n    mean = X.mean(axis=0)\n    cov = np.cov(X, rowvar=False)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(cov)\n    diff = X - mean\n    md2 = np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i', diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    crit = chi2.ppf(0.99, df=len(varset))\n    n_out = (md2>crit).sum()\n    print(varset, 'crit', crit, 'n_outliers', n_out)\n\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":740,"cache_read_input_tokens":42609,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":740,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"bdd2d1d2-7d15-420a-8eac-d7cc6d653c7e","uuid":"8fb60e00-7905-4a1c-8d5c-f421c655df53","request_id":"req_011CcryzmRDn7usoTkCGGrUr"}
